text:
I can't confirm the Sky EPG number for Game Network's May 2001 launch from memory, and I have no source here to check it. The shared note's options (612 or 215) and its claim that Game Network sat in the 600s with youth channels are unverified, so I wouldn't rely on them. A Sky Digital channel guide from 2001 or an archived EPG listing would settle it.

CONFIDENCE: 5
